title: The Midnight Bookstore
author: Barış Kısır
premise: The Midnight Bookstore opens at 11 p.m. and sells only books about the night: dreams, stars, sleep, and the sea after dark. Its owner, Elin, is a night person who never expected company; its newest regular, Sam, is a daytime teacher who can\'t sleep. Their courtship happens between midnight and two, in a shop lit like a lantern.
